dialog.english: Tai, look above you!
Hm? What's that?!
Is that Earth?!

Just like how the Digimon world
looked from Earth, our world has
come to look like this as well.
dialog.translation:
Igual que el Digimundo se veía
desde la Tierra, nuestro mundo
también ha acabado así.

dialog.english: A-aaaaah!
Joe?!
Wait!
Let's go after it!
Yeah!

I can't believe all this happened
to the Digital World while we were
gone...
dialog.translation:
No puedo creer que esto le
pasara al Digimundo mientras
estábamos fuera...

dialog.english: I'm sure *something* hasn't changed.
dialog.translation: Seguro que ALGO no ha cambiado.

dialog.english: Everyone's starting to feel nervous.

I'm sure *something* out there
hasn't changed.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que hay ALGO ahí
que no ha cambiado.

dialog.english: I don't know about that...

Being negative isn't going to help
anything.
dialog.translation:
Ser negativo no va a ayudar
en nada.

dialog.english:
I can't just take this at face
value, not like you can.
dialog.translation:
Yo no puedo tomármelo tan a la
ligera como tú.

dialog.english: Matt...

It's not just you. Everyone's
feeling nervous.
dialog.translation:
No eres el único. Todos
estamos nerviosos.

dialog.english: I know. You, me, all of us.

It'll be fine. We've gotten
through all sorts of bad stuff,
right?
dialog.translation:
Todo irá bien. Hemos pasado
por cosas peores, no?

dialog.english:
You're right. We'll be counting on
you, Tai.
Tai, is this the Digital World?

It's kind of scarier than I heard
it would be...
dialog.translation:
Da más miedo de lo que me
habían contado...

dialog.english:
It wasn't like this when we were
here.
dialog.translation:
No era así cuando estuvimos
aquí.

dialog.english:
I wonder if I can fit in with the
group...
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si encajaré con
el grupo...

dialog.english: Everyone starts off being nervous
You're a Chosen Child, you can do it
dialog.translation:
Eres una Niña Elegida, tú
puedes

dialog.english: Everyone starts off being nervous.
Were you nervous at first?

Yeah, when I came to the Digital
World I was so scared I couldn't
even sleep at night.
dialog.translation:
Sí, cuando llegué al Digimundo
tenía tanto miedo que no podía
dormir por las noches.

dialog.english:
You? Aren't you the one who
normally sleeps like a rock?
dialog.translation:
Tú? No eras el que siempre
duerme como un tronco?

dialog.english: Yeah! So you'll be fine, Kari!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Así que estarás bien,
Kari!

dialog.english:
You're a Chosen Child, so you can
do it.
dialog.translation:
Eres una Niña Elegida, así
que puedes.

dialog.english: But I don't have any confidence...
Just give it time and it'll come!
Okay...
Hey! Come out!
Wait!

Don't be scared. We won't do
anything to you... come out...
dialog.translation:
No tengas miedo. No te
haremos nada... sal...

dialog.english: Hey, aren't you Chuumon?

You're right! It's the Chuumon we
met on File Island!
dialog.translation:
Tienes razón! El Chuumon de
la Isla File!

dialog.english:
Mimi? Palmon? I'm so glad... you
came back...
dialog.translation:
Mimi? Palmon? Qué alegría...
habéis vuelto...

dialog.english:
Chuumon... what on earth happened
to you?

And what happened to your friend,
Scumon?
dialog.translation:
Y qué le pasó a tu amigo
Scumon?

dialog.english: He's deaaaaaaaad!

After Mimi and Palmon left File
Island, we were living out our
ordinary lives...
dialog.translation:
Tras irse Mimi y Palmon de la
Isla File, vivíamos nuestra
vida normal...

dialog.english:
But one day, dark forces covered
the world, and formed a new world
over it...
dialog.translation:
Pero un día, fuerzas oscuras
cubrieron el mundo y crearon
uno nuevo encima...

dialog.english:
All so they could have control
over it themselves... and then,
Scumon fell down a huge hole.
dialog.translation:
Todo para controlarlo ellos
mismos... y entonces, Scumon
cayó por un agujero enorme.

dialog.english:
You said they created a new
world...
What kind of world?
It's called Spiral Mountain.
Spiral Mountain?

They turned the Digimon world into
this...

What happened to the other
Digimon? Like Leomon...
dialog.translation:
Qué pasó con los demás
Digimon? Como Leomon...

dialog.english:
I don't know... but they say that
all who resisted were defeated.
dialog.translation:
No lo sé... pero dicen que
derrotaron a todo el que
se resistió.

dialog.english: By whom?
The Dark Masters.
So we'll have to fight them, then!
Fight them?! You can't do that!

We defeated Vamdemon! It'll be
okay!
dialog.translation:
Vencimos a Myotismon! Todo
irá bien!

dialog.english:
It'll be fine! If the eight of us
Chosen Children are together, we
can save the world!
dialog.translation:
Todo irá bien! Si los ocho
Niños Elegidos estamos juntos,
podemos salvar el mundo!

dialog.english: we can save the world!
we can save the world!
Hah... hahahahaha...

Such lively children. Let's play
with them a little..
dialog.translation:
Qué críos tan animados. Vamos
a jugar con ellos..

dialog.english: W-who's there?!
W-who's there?!
W-who's there?!
Aaaaaaaaah!
Gyaaaaaah! It's Piemon!
Hahahahaha...
T-They're...
The Dark Masters...
Don't worry, guys!

We've got a little trump card of
our own. Right, Agumon?
dialog.translation:
También tenemos una carta de
triunfo, verdad, Agumon?

dialog.english: We're counting on you, Gabumon!

Go! Let's show them what we can
do!
dialog.translation:
Vamos! A enseñarles lo que
valemos!

dialog.english:
MetalGarurumon! We can save the
world if we defeat them!
dialog.translation:
MetalGarurumon! Si los
derrotamos, salvaremos el mundo!

dialog.english: Trump Sword!
No way...

Even two Ultimates are no match
for him...
dialog.translation:
Ni dos Cuerpo Supremo le
hacen frente...

dialog.english:
You may be Ultimates just like me, 
but it hasn't been long since 
you've evolved to that level.
dialog.translation:
Seréis Cuerpo Supremo como yo,
pero no hace mucho que
evolucionasteis a ese nivel.

dialog.english:
You're making a huge mistake if
you think you can win.
dialog.translation:
Cometéis un gran error si
creéis que podéis ganar.

dialog.english:
No! Nooooo! I'm just a normal
elementary school student!
dialog.translation:
No! Noooo! Solo soy un
estudiante normal de primaria!

dialog.english: Why do I have to die here?!
dialog.translation: Por qué he de morir aquí?!

dialog.english: Mimi...

You're annoying. I'll start with
you, then.
Chuumon!
Mimi...
Chuumon! Hang in there!

When I'm reborn... go on a date
with me...
dialog.translation:
Cuando renazca... ten una
cita conmigo...

dialog.english: Chuumon!

What a foolish Digimon. How
pointless, charging in so quickly
into his own death like that.
dialog.translation:
Qué Digimon tan tonto. Qué
inútil correr tan rápido
hacia su propia muerte.

dialog.english:
Why, you! We won't forgive you for
that!
dialog.translation:
Serás...! No te perdonaremos
por eso!

dialog.english: Haha... All right, next is...
Pit Bomb!
Ugh!!
Piccolomon! We've missed you!
I've missed you, too!

Piccolomon! We thought the eight
of us could save this world and
Earth, so we came here!
dialog.translation:
Pensamos que los ocho
podríamos salvar este mundo
y la Tierra, así que vinimos!

dialog.english:
But how are we supposed to do
that?

It's true that you're all
together, pi! But you can't win
with just that, pi!
dialog.translation:
Es verdad que estáis todos
juntos, pi! Pero con eso solo
no podéis ganar, pi!

dialog.english: What are we missing?
Tell us!

Unfortunately, now's not the time,
pi!
dialog.translation:
Por desgracia, no es el
momento, pi!

dialog.english:
I'll hold them off here, pi! Head
to Spiral Mountain while you have
the chance, pi!
dialog.translation:
Yo los entretendré aquí, pi!
Id a la Montaña Espiral
mientras podáis, pi!

dialog.english:
Hold them off? But they're all
Ultimates!

I know, pi! It's impossible for me
to win, but there are still things
I can do, pi!
dialog.translation:
Lo sé, pi! Es imposible que
gane, pero aún puedo hacer
algunas cosas, pi!

dialog.english:
I'm sure you'll be able to find
out what you're missing, pi!
dialog.translation:
Seguro que descubrís qué os
falta, pi!

dialog.english: Go, Chosen Children!
So you're Piccolomon... right?

You expect to put up a serious
fight, even though you're only a
Perfect-level?
dialog.translation:
Esperas plantar cara en serio
aunque solo seas Cuerpo
Perfecto?

dialog.english:
You're in for trouble if you take
me lightly, pi!
dialog.translation:
Os arrepentiréis si me
subestimáis, pi!

dialog.english:
Piccolomon just died, didn't
he...?
With that huge sacrifice...

the children finally arrived at
Spiral Mountain.
dialog.translation:
los niños llegaron por fin a
la Montaña Espiral.

dialog.english:
But their battle with the Dark
Masters had only just begun...
dialog.translation:
Pero su lucha contra los
Amos Oscuros solo empezaba...
